lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the heather meets the stone
Underneath the morning light
Seeds of memory were sown
Before the day turned bright
[Pre-Chorus]

Where the ancient stories begin
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is our song
In the heart of the deep
Where the weary belong
And the memories keep

Oh, the land is our song
In the heart of the deep
Where the weary belong

A flickering fire in the night
Holding the spirit's light
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is our song
In the heart of the deep
Where the weary belong
And the memories keep
[Outro]
